caption: The drawing depicts a single, clear goblet or glass positioned centrally within a rectangular border on off-white paper. The goblet has a broad, slightly outward-curving rim, vertical and petal-shaped facets around the bowl, and rests on a short, ribbed stem that connects to a wide, flat circular base. There is careful attention to shading to indicate the reflective quality of the glass, primarily achieved with black, grey, and white tones. In the bottom left corner, there is a small, inset technical drawing of the same goblet, showing its profile with measurements in fine pencil lines. The composition consists solely of these two elements, with no other objects or background details present.
title: Goblet
